attack.note: Moves while attacking, 10 round magazine, lifesteal on hits. Almost all her output is basic attacks plus Melee and Pulse Bomb. Attack range is short for a ranged hero, so she must stay near targets.

poke.note: She has no real poke tool. Her basic attacks work only up close, and her main damage comes when she dives in. Pulse Bomb is short range and not a harass tool.

damage.note: A hit and run assassin: a stream of fast autos, Melee for burst and a Pulse Bomb that sticks to a target. Single target focus on squishy heroes. Healing helps against her only when it can keep up with a diver, and Melee plus Pulse Bomb are burst. Ricochet adds some spread damage.

good_into.why: Blink, Melee and a stuck Pulse Bomb can delete a low health ranged hero or healer in a couple of seconds; Icy Veins calls her very good against fragile heroes who lack mobility.
Targets that cannot move away are chased down by Blink and Recall, and cannot sidestep Pulse Bomb.
Single target healers struggle to keep up when she bursts a target with Melee and a bomb, and she can also lifesteal back.
She kites melee heroes with Blink and attack while moving, and Jumper shields and charges keep her slippery.
Her mobility and Recall let her catch isolated heroes who are caught away from the team.

bad_into.why: Stuns, silences, polymorphs and knockbacks stop Blink and Melee combos and can prevent Recall, which is her only cleanse.
Heroes with long range basic attacks (Raynor, Sgt. Hammer per the guide) punish her short range and low health.
Area healing and spread damage let a team soak her chip damage and wait out Recall.
She does not deal much against armored tanks and cannot get past a frontline into a backline protected by CC.
She has no reveal for basic abilities, so stealthed assassins escape her chase, though Pulse Bomb can reveal on hit.

wants_from_team: Reliable wave clear so she can focus on heroes
A tank with hard CC to catch targets
A healer who can heal at range (Malfurion style)
Peel because she is fragile when caught
gives_team: Backline pickoffs and threat on enemy squishies
Constant pressure on enemy frontline from the edge of fights
Finishing power on fleeing low health heroes
Map rotations that punish split enemies
weaknesses: Very fragile and easy to kill when controlled
Needs level 7 to deal decent damage
Hard CC with no Recall available ends her
evidence: Blink, Melee, Recall, Pulse Bomb, Reload ability text
Jumper, Pulse Generator, Ricochet, Get Stuffed! talent text
Icy Veins weaknesses (extremely poor waveclear, very fragile)
